description: This file defines Flask route handlers for CRUD operations on notes, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, using Flask-Smorest and class-based views.

classes.name: NotesCollection
classes.description: Class-based view handling collection operations for notes, such as listing all notes and creating a new note.

classes.name: NoteItem
classes.description: Class-based view handling operations on a single note, including retrieving, updating, and deleting a specific note.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all notes.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by ID.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update an existing note by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a note by ID.
